item.title: NMA CEO Owen Meredith Appointed Managing Director, Public Policy, At Dmg Media - News Media Association
item.description: News Media Association chief executive Owen Meredith has been appointed managing director, public policy, at dmg media starting in May 2026. He will replace editor emeritus Peter Wright, who will be retiring after 47 years with the company. Owen has led the NMA for five years, spearheading the industry’s engagement with government, regulators, and stakeholders. […]
